comment:
* Callback for receiving updates on from the session. A Callback can be
     * registered using {@link #registerCallback}

methods.name: public void onSessionDestroyed()
methods.comment:
* Override to handle the session being destroyed. The session is no
         * longer valid after this call and calls to it will be ignored.

methods.name: public void onSessionEvent(String event, Bundle extras)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle custom events sent by the session owner without a
         * specified interface. Controllers should only handle these for
         * sessions they own.
         *
         * @param event The event from the session.
         * @param extras Optional parameters for the event.

methods.name: public void onPlaybackStateChanged(PlaybackStateCompat state)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle changes in playback state.
         *
         * @param state The new playback state of the session

methods.name: public void onMetadataChanged(MediaMetadataCompat metadata)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle changes to the current metadata.
         *
         * @param metadata The current metadata for the session or null if none.
         * @see MediaMetadata

methods.name: public void onQueueChanged(List<MediaSessionCompat.QueueItem> queue)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle changes to items in the queue.
         *
         * @see MediaSessionCompat.QueueItem
         * @param queue A list of items in the current play queue. It should
         *            include the currently playing item as well as previous and
         *            upcoming items if applicable.

methods.name: public void onQueueTitleChanged(CharSequence title)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle changes to the queue title.
         *
         * @param title The title that should be displayed along with the play
         *            queue such as "Now Playing". May be null if there is no
         *            such title.

methods.name: public void onExtrasChanged(Bundle extras)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle chagnes to the {@link MediaSessionCompat} extras.
         *
         * @param extras The extras that can include other information
         *            associated with the {@link MediaSessionCompat}.

methods.name: public void onAudioInfoChanged(PlaybackInfo info)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle changes to the audio info.
         *
         * @param info The current audio info for this session.

methods.name: private void setHandler(Handler handler)
methods.comment: * Set the handler to use for pre 21 callbacks.
